test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Given here are four sentences. The first sentence is in correct order, while the rest of the sentences are jumbled. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. On the last day of the training, I received an e-mail from my training manager, Jane.

B. I wondered if I had done anything wrong.

C. She had called me to her office.

D. Once I had skipped classes to watch a movie and a football game.
solution:
The correct answer is "ACBD"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement A is the opening sentence of the passage which explains that **The training manager, Jane, sent the speaker an email on the last day of the course.**
 
• Statement C is the second sentence of the passage which explains that **The speaker was summoned to her office by her.**
 
• Statement B is the third sentence of the passage which explains **The speaker questioned whether he had made a mistake.**
 
• Statement D is the last sentence of the passage which shows that **To watch a movie and a football game, he once missed class.**

Hence, the correct sequence is A, C, B, D

The correct answer is option 2.

The correct passage is: ***A**. On the last day of the training, I received an e-mail from my training manager, Jane. **C**. She had called me to her office. **B**. I wondered if I had done anything wrong. **D**. Once I had skipped classes to watch a movie and a football game. *
